messages:
sofia: Quick check — playing with a compact thresholds list where we compress adjacent rules with identical channels/notify policies. Sketch attached: rows collapse into a summary row with a chevron to expand. Thoughts?
jamal: ooo can you paste the sketch here?
sofia: pasted SVG link: https://internal-assets/redwood/sketches/compact-thresholds-v2.svg
marie: main concern is discoverability. collapsed rows hide the exact metric/expr which we need for on-call debugging. maybe show a 1-line breadcrumb: `errors > 5% for 5m`?
dan: Agree with marie. Suggestion: summary shows truncated expression + pill tags for channels and severity. On expand you get full expression and preview.
ciara: Accessibility nit: if the row is collapsible it needs clear aria-expanded and keyboard target for the whole row (not just the chevron). Also ensure focus ring stays visible in dark mode.
sofia: Yup — keyboard flow is on the list. Current idea: entire row is a button with `role=button` and `aria-expanded`. chevron has `aria-hidden=true`.
jamal: For the preview of notifications (channel weighting) — can we show which channel would actually receive the alert after routing? i.e. primary == page, secondary == email. The current preview confuses engs who see all channels listed but don't know priority.
marie: Maybe add a small badge on the left: P1 / P2 / Fallback with color + hover tooltip saying "routing policy: primary -> fallback after 1 min".
dan: UX question: what should happen in canary/capacity mode where routing falls back to a cheaper model? Do we surface that in the alert preview? I think yes but subtle: render a gray hint line: "If dedicated capacity unavailable, fallback: standard-hosted"
ciara: Copy tweak: change "Mute for" to "Snooze notifications for" — "mute" reads like permanent. Small but lots of confusion in support tickets.
sofia: Good call. Also debating compact copy for the collapsed row: keep it under 60 chars to avoid overflow in narrow panes.
jamal: Edge-case: multiple thresholds that only differ by lookback window — compressing by metric+channels will group them and expand view needs to show the differing window lines clearly. Avoid hiding them under a tooltip.
marie: Can we show an inline diff when you expand? Like bullet list: • 5m window — triggers page, • 15m window — email only. Quick scanable.
dan: Visual weight — the collapsed summary should not compete with the channel preview pill. Use lighter bg + 12px caption for the summary, and stronger 13-14px for channel pills.
ciara: A11y test: ensure screen reader reads "3 thresholds grouped for metric X, press enter to expand". Also that expand/collapse anim doesn't steal focus.
sofia: I'll iterate on the mock: implement breadcrumb + inline diff + priority badge + updated copy (Snooze). Will also add keyboard shims.
ux-bot: Reminder: design review tomorrow 10:30am PT — add this to the agenda and bring the mock. :calendar:
